1.note: The saying is in Avot 1:1; kept as printed.

2.note: Havinenu is discussed in Berakhot 29a; kept as printed.

4.note: The ordinance on reading the curses is in Megillah 31b; kept as printed.

7.note: Phrase from Nahum 1:12 in reversed order; rendered by sense.

8.note: Printed as 115; the verses 'I love ... all men are liars' are Psalm 116:1–11.

9.note: As printed; the shortened Hallel is said on the last six days of Passover.

11.note: Figures unclear in the scan; the capture of the citadel with palm branches is 1 Maccabees 13:51.

13.note: The story of the hidden fire is in 2 Maccabees 1:18–36; kept as printed.

14.note: First word broken in the scan (looks like רבר); read as רבוי, plural.
